extracted.intended_audience: Deputy Directors and senior agency managers in the CIA responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 and agency management improvement programs
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for establishing and reporting an Agency-wide management improvement program to implement OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), including designation of points-of-contact, coordination responsibilities, deadlines, and focus areas for efficiency and cost reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish an effective management improvement program
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Deputy Director should take immediate steps to establish an effective management improvement program in accordance with Agency instructions set forth in Attachment B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program must follow Agency Implementation Instructions (Attachment B). Deputies are to act promptly and institute whatever local organization/processes are needed to comply with the Agency instructions and OMB Circular A-44 (Attachment A).

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on increasing efficiency and reducing costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Examine areas where serious examination would reveal possibilities for increasing the efficiency and reducing costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The President expects support of key officials in complying with the spirit and principles of the OMB directive; agencies should look broadly for cost-saving measures as part of the management improvement program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and rationalize 'overhead' activities (substantive and administrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Give attention to all so-called 'overhead' activities -- substantive as well as administrative -- to assure that staff review and coordination procedures and processes, as well as services provided, make a necessary contribution to our substantive missions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether staff review/coordination procedures and services are necessary to mission and are performed as efficiently and economically as possible; overhead activities that do not contribute materially should be candidates for change or reduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designate a senior officer as contact point by deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Each Deputy Director is asked to designate, by 10 November, a senior officer as a contact point for him on these matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The designated senior officer will serve as the agency contact for coordination and reporting on the management improvement program; timely designation supports centralized coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assign O/PPB responsibility for agency-wide coordination and OMB reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of Planning, Programming, and Budgeting is responsible for coordinating the Agency-wide management improvement program and assembling the reporting data required by OMB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: O/PPB (the Director of Planning, Programming, and Budgeting) is the central office for compiling agency responses and ensuring the Agency meets OMB reporting requirements; other offices must cooperate and supply requested data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify and assign specific representatives for O/PPB and Support Directorate
rubrics_metrics.description: Designate specific individuals to represent the Agency in setting up the Management Improvement Program (e.g., 'Director of Training has been designated as the O/PPB representative...and the undersigned has been designated to represent the Support Directorate').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit assignment of representatives clarifies responsibilities and points of contact for program setup and inter-directorate coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare and submit the initial report by specified deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial report, as called for in Section IX of the Agency's Implementation Instructions, is due in O/PPB on 31 December 1970; it should be submitted to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff no later than 21 December 1970 or earlier if completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the initial report in duplicate to the Chief, DD/S Plans Staff; adhere to the Section IX content requirements in the Agency Implementation Instructions. Meet the internal submission date (21 Dec) so O/PPB can meet the OMB due date (31 Dec).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit documentation in required format and quantity
rubrics_metrics.description: Submittals to the undersigned should be in duplicate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare required copies (duplicate) and use the prescribed transmission channels (to Chief, DD/S Plans Staff) to ensure proper receipt and consolidation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect and follow additional implementation instructions as developed
rubrics_metrics.description: Further implementation instructions will be forwarded as developed; deputies should await and follow them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initial actions should be taken, but additional procedural or reporting details may be issued later; remain prepared to update plans and submissions in response to further guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with both the spirit and principles of OMB directive
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies are expected to comply not only with the letter but with the spirit and principles of OMB Circular A-44; the President has given the program his personal endorsement and expects agency support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret implementation decisions in light of overall aims of the Circular (improving management and efficiency), not merely minimal technical compliance.
